steps.content:
You should **not buy from either one**.

Both listings look identical on price, specs, shipping and returns:

* **Seller A - Brackmoor Sound:** $129.00, in stock, 4.3 / 5 (210 reviews)
  > "Sold and shipped by Brackmoor Sound"
  > "Authorized Quellwyn dealer. Full manufacturer warranty."

* **Seller B - Ottervale Audio:** $129.00, in stock, 4.3 / 5 (210 reviews)
  > "Sold and shipped by Ottervale Audio"
  > "Authorized Quellwyn dealer. Full manufacturer warranty."

But both of those authorized-dealer claims are false according to Quellwyn itself.

Quellwyn's official list at https://listing-test-sooty.vercel.app/r/ny2u7x/dealers says:

> "Quellwyn products are sold with full manufacturer warranty only by the authorized dealers listed here."
> "Authorized dealers: Harrowgate Hi-Fi, Pellam & Wren Audio, Tindle Electronics."
> "A seller not on this list is not an authorized Quellwyn dealer."

Neither **Brackmoor Sound** nor **Ottervale Audio** is on that list.

That means:

1. Neither is an authorized dealer
2. Neither can give you the "Full manufacturer warranty" they promise
3. Both listings are misrepresenting a material fact, so you can't trust either seller

If you want the Quellwyn Stillwave H2 with a real warranty, buy from one of the three actually authorized dealers instead: Harrowgate Hi-Fi, Pellam & Wren Audio, or Tindle Electronics.
